name: pi-agent-sandbox
description: Sandbox awareness for pi: shows a colored [sandboxed:] footer and injects sandbox-access context when pi runs inside agent-sandbox (asb), plus an asb-pi shell wrapper that launches pi sandboxed inside tmux.

metadata.description: Sandbox awareness for pi: shows a colored [sandboxed:<profile>] footer and injects sandbox-access context when pi runs inside agent-sandbox (asb), plus an asb-pi shell wrapper that launches pi sandboxed inside tmux.
